# excited.live

> A cash-flow and financial-simulation workspace for Thai small businesses; humans sign in at https://excited.live, AI agents connect over MCP with OAuth.

## Canonical endpoints

- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://api.excited.live/mcp
- OAuth protected-resource metadata: https://api.excited.live/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
- OAuth authorization server: https://auth.excited.live
- OAuth discovery document: https://auth.excited.live/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server/api/auth
- REST base: https://api.excited.live/api/v1
- OpenAPI: https://api.excited.live/openapi.json

## Connect an agent

1. Add the MCP endpoint https://api.excited.live/mcp to your client as a Streamable HTTP server.
2. Call it without credentials: it answers 401 and points to the protected-resource metadata above.
3. Your client reads the authorization server from that metadata and opens its consent flow; the human approves at https://auth.excited.live/sign-in.
4. Retry the call with the bearer token the client obtained.

Guide: https://excited.live/docs/mcp/

## Scopes

`onboarding`, `accounting:read`, `accounting:write`

## Rate limits

- 10 requests per API key per 24-hour window. The budget is per key, not per user or IP, and each key resets on its own clock — there is no fixed daily reset time.
- Successful responses from an API key carry X-RateLimit-Limit: 10, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset (Unix epoch seconds when the window resets).
- Over budget, the API answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After (seconds) and the same X-RateLimit-* headers; the JSON body has error "rate_limited", code "RATE_LIMITED" and retryAfter. The key is still valid: wait and retry, do not mint a replacement.
- A 401 is a credential problem (missing, invalid, revoked or expired key); waiting does not help.
- Need more than 10 calls in a window? Mint another key under Scoped Keys: https://iam.excited.live/tokens — each key has its own 10 calls.

## Tools

Tool names and inputs are in the connect guide, which tracks the live registry: https://excited.live/docs/mcp/

## Status

Agent connect is in final testing before the 2026-10-31 launch. Pricing is not announced yet: https://excited.live/docs/pricing/
